peel noun

rind of fruit

also rind, apple peel, orange peel, skin (of fruit)

classical

Traupman 358

cortex, corticis m.

noun, third declension

rind or peel

Also sometimes feminine in ancient usage.

Other words

  • corium, coriī n. — thick rind, skin (of fruit)

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Plin. NH 15.112 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 371

Examples

  • Sēmina exime; corticem abjice.

    Remove the seeds; throw away the peel.composed

  • mālī cutis

    apple peelTraupman 358

  • corium mālī aurantiī

    orange peelTraupman 358

See also skin, peel, remove, float.
